headline: What Mistakes Do People Make When Converting a Garage?
articleBody: Converting your garage into a usable living space can truly transform your home, but it's easy to make a few common missteps that can derail your project. One biggie is skipping the permit process. Trying to convert your garage without proper permits can lead to fines, stop-work orders, and even requiring you to undo all the work. Los Angeles County cities like West Hollywood and Santa Monica have clear rules you need to follow. Another frequent mistake is neglecting proper insulation and climate control. Garages are usually not built for year-round comfort, so ignoring insulation, heating, and cooling can leave you with a space that's too hot or too cold. Many also overlook plumbing and electrical upgrades. Your garage likely only has basic utilities, and a living space will need much more, which means careful planning for new lines. Then there's the design aspect—trying to cram too much into the space or creating a layout that feels cramped and awkward. Lastly, hiring an unlicensed or inexperienced contractor can lead to poor workmanship and budget overruns. To avoid these headaches, always work with a licensed and insured general contractor, like Cali View Builders, who understands the intricacies of garage conversions and can guide you every step of the way.
